steps: Create a free account at quickrewards.net (US/Canada, 18+, one per household).
Complete the profile and any profiler surveys to unlock matched survey routers.
Earn via daily survey routers, paid emails, videos, offers, or cashback shopping links.
Open the cashout page and request a PayPal redemption for any amount (no minimum).
Receive the PayPal payment, usually within 72 hours of request.
timing: PayPal redemptions usually processed within 72 hours of request.
what_gets_accepted: Completed surveys, watched videos, completed offers, and tracked cashback purchases credit automatically.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No monetary cost. Unpaid time: profile setup, survey screen-outs, and offer crediting delays up to 24 hours.
numeric_basis: Official: no minimum PayPal cashout, 72-hour processing. $1-$5 first-session range is an honest estimate from a handful of survey-router completions including screen-outs (estimate, not a provider promise). Time = 15-60 min active honest estimate.
when_cash_arrives: PayPal, usually within 72 hours of cashout request; gift-card options slower.
who_pays: QuickRewards Network (survey routers, offer walls, and merchant cashback partners that fund the rewards).
who_qualifies: A real US/Canada adult whose genuine demographics, opinions, and shopping behavior match what survey routers and cashback merchants are buying — AI cannot fabricate lived purchase history or truthful consumer profiles, and the platform bans VPN/proxy use, binding earnings to one real household.
work_available: Routers and daily emails provide steady inventory; survey availability varies by demographic profile.
